value.name: Asha withholds her full explanation
value.description: Asha begins to answer Whitfield but stops after giving only a partial explanation, holding back the rest of the story.
evidence: "My father required urgent medical attention," she said, and stopped there
she did not yet say the rest—the corridor, the wire, the savings—though both of them now understood that the rest existed

value.name: Whitfield shifts attention to Asha
value.description: Whitfield stops focusing on Devin's signature and looks directly at Asha, signaling that he is now listening to her account.
evidence: Whitfield's two fingers stayed on the corner of the page, but his eyes moved off Devin's signature for the first time and found her face

value.name: Asha reveals her emotional wall is cracking
value.description: Asha realizes that Whitfield's attention has begun to break down the emotional barrier she has maintained for years.
evidence: she felt the wall she had spent ten years keeping take its first real bruise

value.name: Asha refuses to look away
value.description: Asha holds Whitfield's gaze and deliberately keeps control over what she will disclose next.
evidence: she was the one who would decide whether it crossed the desk

value.name: Asha ignores Rosa's warning text
value.description: Asha feels her phone buzz with Rosa's message urging her to mention the wire, but she chooses not to answer it.
evidence: the phone buzzed once more against her hip with what she already knew was Rosa's last word on it: the window is open, tell him the wire
She did not reach for it

value.name: Asha hints at financial trouble
value.description: Asha says the financial arrangements became complicated, implying a deposit and shortfall without naming them directly.
evidence: "The financial arrangements became complicated," she said
leaving the shape of a deposit and a shortfall to settle in the air above Devin's signature without naming either

value.name: Whitfield reassesses Asha's disclosure
value.description: Whitfield subtly changes his expression as he waits to hear more, indicating he understands there is more to the story.
evidence: Whitfield's two fingers stayed on the corner of the page, but something at the edge of his mouth adjusted, the small recalibration of a man who had been waiting to hear wheth
